observation.visible_scene: A clear glass bowl filled with water rests on a white ledge in front of a balcony glass railing; behind it is a cityscape with a tall tower, low buildings, trees, and a cloudy sky. A thin tan stream descends vertically from the top edge of the frame into the center of the bowl, and a broad pale vertical column is seen through the water below the entry point. The bowl carries a frosted palm-frond etching across its midsection.
visible_changes: The thin tan stream stays continuous for the whole excerpt; its upper portion drifts slightly left then right, producing a gentle change in tilt while the point where it meets the water surface remains near the bowl's center.
The pale submerged column persists throughout, shifting only marginally in horizontal position in step with the stream's small sway.
The railing, bowl rim, and background cityscape hold fixed positions, consistent with a static camera.
No visible change in water level, splashing, or appearance of new objects occurs within the segment.
outside_clip_unknowns: The source and true nature of the stream (liquid vs. thin solid) lie above the frame and are unseen.
Whether the bowl is filling toward an overflow, or whether the stream ever stops, is outside the excerpt.
uncertain_details: It is unclear whether the pale column is the refracted/magnified submerged part of the stream or a separate object inside the bowl.
Fine surface ripples or minute level changes are not resolvable.
The dark shape at the very top edge may be part of the pouring apparatus but is too cropped to confirm.
